headline: 1 Software Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 We Find Risky
summary: Software is rapidly reducing operating expenses for businesses. This secular theme has materialized in superior earnings growth and stock price performance for most SaaS companies, and over the last six months, the industry’s 13.5% return has topped the S&P 500 by 8.6 percentage points.
